caption:
Every pillow claims to fix your neck. Most of them are shaped for people who sleep on their back.

On your side, a flat pillow tilts your neck down toward the mattress — that gap is where the crook in your neck comes from, not just a rough night.

Eli & Elm built theirs for the position you're actually in: a U-shape with a shoulder cutout, plus adjustable latex-fiber fill you pack in or pull out to match your shoulder width.

Spine level, shoulder supported, no digging around for the one flat side at 3am.
